keys.heading: Keys
keys.intro: Every action of the reading screen has a key. Leave a field empty to take the key away; the action stays in the command palette.
keys.notation: A key is a character (j, J, ?), a named key (Space, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Backspace, Delete, Insert, F1 to F12), either one with Ctrl+, Alt+ or Meta+ before it, or two keys pressed one after the other, written with a space between them (g u). Enter, Escape and Ctrl+K always do the same.
keys.single: Keys pressed alone, without Ctrl, Alt or Meta, are on
